instrument_changed: From per-feature drug-vs-state comparison to a between-FAMILY difference of differences, plus multiplicity control and an exhaustive shuffled-family placebo. The cohort is deliberately unchanged, so this cannot confirm E35 — it can only kill it. Stated in the file first paragraph.
outcome_detail: SURVIVES, with the primary at its boundary and the placebo decisive. P1: Delta +0.2750 [+0.0013,+0.3358], one-sided bootstrap p=0.0242 at 20k resamples; NOT stable to the RNG seed at the registered 2000 reps (1 of 5 seeds straddles zero) -> error-catalogue rule 46. The informative decomposition is D +0.2576 [+0.0203,+0.2880] against S -0.0174 [-0.1070,+0.0812]: the insensitivity explanation is excluded to within +/-0.10, and Delta is marginal because D is noisy (10 dex patients), not because S is uncertain. P2: the physically-defined split is the UNIQUE maximum of all 495 exhaustive 4/8 splits (p=0.002), and remains the argmax under all 4 leave-one-outs of PHASE. P2 shows the split is extreme, NOT that it was chosen blind - it was not, and the file says so. P3: effective_tests 9.84/12; only EffDim and NmlzCmplx survive FWER 0.05; PHASE raw p 0.62-0.9995, i.e. at the LOW extreme of the null. P0: nuisance floor 0.196 (Subdural) falls exactly between the families. P4 registered wording corrected in the outcome block: the band does not rebalance the arms (dex fraction 0.338 -> 0.336); it is a stability check, not a confound control. STRUCTURAL LIMIT: 0 of 29 patients shared between arms and both nuisance channels patient-constant, so agent cannot be separated from patient-level covariates in this deposit by any method. POST-HOC (not registered, for a successor to pre-register): the mundane explanation - phase measures are just artefact-robust - fails within-arm, where PHASE is MORE legible of Subdural than AMPLITUDE (0.243 vs 0.202 propofol; 0.344 vs 0.288 dex). Cannot confirm E35: same rows.
placebo: P2: all 495 exhaustive 4/8 splits of the 12 primary features; the real Delta must reach the 97.5th percentile of that distribution. Evaluated AFTER the primary and gates the verdict.
primary: Delta = (mean AMPLITUDE drug legibility - mean PHASE drug legibility) - (same difference in pooled state legibility). 95% patient-clustered bootstrap CI must exclude 0. Delta separates agent-invariance from insensitivity; D alone cannot.
question: Is E35 measure-family split (phase-coupling features leak little drug identity; power and complexity features leak a lot) real, or a post-hoc line through 13 noisy numbers?

outcome_detail: NOT MET at P3b. Critical slowing IS detectable and adds nothing. G1 passed after an estimator correction made before any candidate was scored (see the file): 70 recordings, 38,684 windows, base rate 21.7%, position distance 0.140. Added gate (f): 43.4% of conscious windows lack an EWS estimate and the exclusion-vs-label AUC is 0.548 (distance 0.048, ceiling 0.10) - large but not appreciably outcome-related. P2 incumbent SEF95 0.645 [0.584,0.706] here vs 0.610 [0.571,0.650] in E34; the EWS estimator needs 360 s of history so this sub-cohort is 70 of E34 129 recordings and the incumbent does slightly BETTER in it, i.e. the bar was higher not lower. P3a PASSED: ar1_sef95 0.582 [0.524,0.635] out-of-fold in the direction signed in advance by PMID 14525001 / PMID 30011536, Westfall-Young adjusted p 0.0010, effective_tests 3.00 of 3. First Challenge C candidate in five designs to clear chance in a pre-signed direction. P3b FAILED: increment over SEF95 level +0.0007 [-0.0539,+0.0295]. P4 under-powered rather than 2-of-3 supportive: every spread is an order of magnitude wider than its median; sync_alpha FALLS toward the loss, against the coherence rise John et al. 2001 reported. P5 passed and should be disregarded - a placebo cannot validate a null increment (error-catalogue rule 48). P6 descriptive: AUC 0.561 at 30 s decaying to 0.497 by 180 s, so the signal is short-lived. The 30 s sensitivity arm could not run: MIN_PAIRS=30 exceeds the 29 pairs a 30-sample window contains. CHALLENGE C CONSTRAINT: three instruments, three reportable verdicts, all failing in the same place - above chance, not above the incumbent (E34 +0.0178, E37 +0.0007). A successor should test whether SOC as a charted flag imposes the ceiling, rather than look for a better feature.
placebo: P5: E34 fake landmark, a cut drawn uniformly in the middle 70% of each recording with the 60 s before it labelled positive. Evaluated AFTER the primary; the primary is WITHDRAWN if the placebo increment reaches the real one. E34 placebo did reach its real increment, which is why this gate is not optional.
primary: ar1_sef95: lag-1 autocorrelation of detrended SEF95 over a trailing 60 s window. Directional AUC (declared HIGHER, from PMID 14525001 / PMID 30011536), out-of-fold with recording-level folds; and an out-of-bag increment over SEF95 level.
question: Does critical slowing down -- rising variance and lag-1 autocorrelation in the incumbent own trajectory -- precede loss of consciousness earlier than the incumbent level does?
